lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance blobs are arranged in a multi-layered grid-like array posterior to the fifth gill slit, with approximately five primary horizontal rows of varying density extending toward the caudal region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of higher pixel intensity are present, intersecting with the horizontal rows of blobs to create a series of anchor points, most prominent in the mid-lateral section.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the lateral flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient transition from high-intensity upper edges to shadowed lower boundaries.

other_distinctive_markers: Two small secondary silhouettes of accompanying fish are visible: one near the ventral termination of the fourth and fifth gill slits and one below the primary pectoral fin.
